agent.problem: This story card explicitly says that Jehu strikes down everyone belonging to Ahab who remained in Samaria. Card 11 then asks the baker to affirm that same action, so the story card gives away the choice card's answer.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.
